summary: Recognize exact Gmail and Outlook HTML reply wrappers so prior RFI or Submittal history stays reviewable but cannot alter the current workflow state or enter model extraction input.
decision_refs: Active user goal to improve efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content
Synthetic regression showing prior Approved Submittal history merged into the current Pending message
Existing deterministic rule that quoted history remains reviewable but is excluded from current requirement extraction
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requires continued efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Only exact Gmail gmail_quote or gmail_quote_container classes and Outlook divRplyFwdMsg IDs are recognized; arbitrary visual indentation is not guessed as history.
Mailbox synchronization, semantic thread inference and automatic attachment recursion remain unsupported.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or paid provider was used.
